projection.visibility: one minimum-depth sample per anchor/pixel, then a cross-anchor z-buffer with absolute-or-relative tolerance

metrics.mask_hit_ratio: exact visible projected anchor pixels inside the SAM3 mask divided by visible projected anchor pixels
metrics.dilated_support_ratio: SAM3 mask pixels covered by the dilated visible anchor projection divided by SAM3 mask pixels
metrics.bbox_iou: visible anchor projection bbox versus decoded PNG mask bbox
metrics.assignment: maximum-weight one-to-one assignment per frame with dummy unmatched columns
